title: 恢复漫游中的移动数据
request: 用户在境外，移动数据无法使用或很慢，希望恢复连接。
beats: Checked the line and enabled carrier roaming.
Checked the line and enabled carrier roaming.
Changed network settings; selected speed test still showed no connection.
Checked the quota early: 15.1 GB used against a 15.0 GB limit.
Only checked usage near the end. The trace contains no data top-up.
Added 2 GB, corrected device settings, and verified 275 Mbps.
Reward 0. The trajectory reached its step limit without restoring service.
Reward 1. Device speed test verified the recovered connection.
refs: Baseline: speed tests at messages 32, 46, 56; quota at 59.
Optimized: quota at message 15; top-up at 23; speed test at 42.

title: 找到历史航班并完成订票
en: Find and rebook a past flight
request: 用户希望订购同一条航线、与历史行程相同的航班，供两位乘客出行。
beats: Repeated flight searches without opening the prior reservations.
Opened historical reservations and identified the matching flight.
The simulator requested a human handoff. No booking was written.
Created the matching one-way booking for two passengers.
Reward 0. No matching booking was created.
Reward 1. The simulator confirmed the booking.
refs: Baseline: searches at messages 5, 7, 11 and 13; no booking call in the complete trace.
Optimized: reservation reads at messages 7–15 and booking at message 23; tool result contained two passengers.
